2610.01718.title: vFedProtoQNAS: Prototype-Guided Personalized Quantum Neural Architecture Search for Virtual Federated Learning
2610.01718.paper_summary: Quantum federated learning (QFL) has emerged as a promising approach for collaboratively training compact quantum neural networks (QNNs) over distributed private data on resource-constrained devices. However, differences in device capabilities make a single shared QNN architecture unsuitable for all clients. While personalized quantum neural architecture search (QNAS) allows each client to select a device-specific QNN, averaging parameters across structurally different QNN architectures mixes semantically inconsistent circuit operations. To address this, prototype-guided personalized QNAS for virtual FL (vFedProtoQNAS) is proposed, where model parameters are never aggregated across clients and federated collaboration is achieved through class-wise prototype sharing. Each client independently searches and trains a client-specific QNN, computes class-wise local prototypes from latent representations, and refines them using global prototypes from the server as federated semantic anchors. Experiments demonstrate that vFedProtoQNAS improves accuracy by 3.70\% over FedAvg and enhances class-consistent representation alignment.
2610.01718.paper_summary_zh: 量子聯邦學習（QFL）已成為一種有前景的方法，用於在資源有限的設備上協作訓練緊湊的量子神經網絡（QNNs），以處理分散的私有數據。<lb/>然而，設備能力的差異使得單一共享的QNN架構不適合所有客戶端。<lb/>雖然個性化量子神經架構搜索（QNAS）允許每個客戶端選擇特定於設備的QNN，但在結構上不同的QNN架構之間平均參數會混合語義不一致的電路操作。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，提出了針對虛擬聯邦學習（vFedProtoQNAS）的原型引導個性化QNAS，在這裡模型參數從不在客戶端之間聚合，聯邦協作是通過類別級原型共享來實現的。<lb/>每個客戶端獨立搜索和訓練特定於客戶端的QNN，從潛在表示中計算類別級本地原型，並使用來自伺服器的全局原型進行精煉，作為聯邦語義錨點。<lb/>實驗表明，vFedProtoQNAS的準確率比FedAvg提高了3.70\%，並增強了類別一致的表示對齊。
